description: Trigger a workflow through its Webhook node. Calls {instance}/webhook/{path} (or /webhook-test/{path} with test=true, which requires the workflow open in 'Listen for test event' mode). In queue mode the call returns according to the webhook's response mode.

method.description: HTTP method the Webhook node expects

path.description: Webhook path as configured in the Webhook node (without /webhook/ prefix)

payload.description: JSON body to send (POST/PUT/DELETE — not allowed with GET)

test.description: Call the test URL (/webhook-test/) instead of production

name: run_webhook
